title: Consumer dedup: the effect and the processed id commit together
caption: The broker may deliver a message twice; writing the id and the effect in one transaction makes the second delivery a no-op.

steps.text: The producer publishes OrderPlaced with a stable id (message id or order_id + event type).
Delivery is at-least-once: after a crash or a rebalance the same message comes back.
In one transaction: INSERT the id into processed_ids (unique) and write the label. A duplicate fails the insert, so the worker skips the effect and acks.

scenarios.name: Effect outside the txn
scenarios.summary: When the effect is an external call (a carrier API), it can't share the database transaction: a crash after the call and before the commit prints a second label on redelivery.

steps.text: It asks the carrier to create a label: the label exists now.
It crashes before inserting the id into its database.
The broker redelivers; the id isn't in the table, so the worker calls the carrier again: two labels.
Fix: pass the message id to the carrier as its idempotency key, so the chain dedupes end to end.

scenarios.name: Alternative: upsert by id
scenarios.summary: No seen-ids table: write the label row keyed by order_id with an upsert. A redelivery rewrites the same row, but this only works for effects you can express as state.

steps.text: OrderPlaced #81 arrives, possibly for the second time.
INSERT … ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE writes the same label row both times: no extra state to keep or expire.
Limit: 'add $5 to the balance' or 'send an email' can't be an upsert, so those still need a dedup id.

scenarios.name: Risk: window too short
scenarios.summary: Seen ids are kept for an hour, but an operator replays two days of the topic: the old ids have expired, so every replayed message is processed again. Size the window to the longest replay horizon.

steps.text: After a bug fix, the topic is replayed from two days ago.
Messages that were handled yesterday come back.
Their ids aged out of processed_ids long ago, so the insert succeeds and a second label is written.
Mitigation: a window longer than any replay, or dedupe on a business id (order_id) that never expires.
